results.title: ‘Disgusting’: Entourage Creator Fires Back After Debi Mazar Criticizes HBO Hit as ‘Toxic’
results.description: The creator of Entourage has hit back at Debi Mazar after the actor described the show’s set as “toxic.” He rejected her claims that she was treated differently following her second pregnancy, calling the allegations “disgusting” in a post on X (formerly Twitter).
